sloka: कर्दमः प्रथमः तेषाम् विकृतः तद् अनन्तरम् ।शेषः च संश्रयः चैव बहु पुत्रः च वीर्यवान्  ॥३-१४-७॥
transliteration: kardamaḥ prathamaḥ teṣām vikṛtaḥ tad anantaram ।śeṣaḥ ca saṁśrayaḥ caiva bahu putraḥ ca vīryavān  ॥3-14-7॥

translations.english: O Rama among the lords of all beings the first was Kardama, the next was Vikritha, followed by Sesha, Samsrya Bahuputra, Sthanu, Mareechi, Atri and mighty Kratu, Pulastya, Angirasa, Pracheta, similarly Pulaha and Daksha.Following them were Vivasvan, Arishtanemi and the very glorious Kasyapa who was the last ruler.
